command:
set -eu
useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin --comment 'Inventory worker service account' inventorysvc
getent passwd inventorysvc
passwd -S inventorysvc

set -eu
useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /sbin/nologin --comment 'Inventory worker service account' inventorysvc
getent passwd inventorysvc
passwd -S inventorysvc

set -eu
install -d -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system
cat > /etc/systemd/system/inventory-worker.service <<'ANTRIEB_EOF'
[Unit]
Description=Inventory worker
After=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=simple
User=inventorysvc
Group=inventorysvc
ExecStart=/usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker
Restart=on-failure
RestartSec=5s
NoNewPrivileges=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ProtectHome=yes
ProtectSystem=strict

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target

systemctl enable --now inventory-worker.service
systemctl is-enabled inventory-worker.service
